verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no user-configurable automation engine in which users define event-to-action rules. The Linter's natural-language rules are content style checks, not triggers. The GitHub AI Writer reacts to pull requests automatically, but it is a fixed built-in feature, not a rule users define, so it is only an adjacent feature. No webhooks or custom trigger/action configuration are documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
